questions.question_text: What is a key advantage of using a smartphone for video creation compared to a DSLR camera?

options.text: Smartphones always have better video quality than DSLRs
Smartphones are more expensive but offer superior manual controls
Smartphones are portable, easy to use, and can shoot HD video right from your pocket
Smartphones allow for interchangeable lenses for cinematic effects

correct_answer.text: Smartphones are portable, easy to use, and can shoot HD video right from your pocket

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of a storyboard in video planning?

options.text: To write detailed dialogue for every scene in the video
To create a visual map of shots and scenes to organize the video’s flow
To list all the equipment needed for filming
To edit the video after filming is complete

correct_answer.text: To create a visual map of shots and scenes to organize the video’s flow

questions.question_text: Which shooting technique would you use to make a subject look powerful or intimidating in a video?

options.text: Eye-Level Angle
High Angle (Looking Down)
Low Angle (Looking Up)
Wide Shot

questions.question_text: Why is recording quality audio important for videos, and how can you improve it on a budget?

options.text: Audio doesn’t matter as long as the visuals are good; use any mic
Clear audio keeps viewers engaged; use a cheap lavalier mic or earbuds with a built-in mic
Audio is only important for music videos; record in noisy areas for realism
Good audio requires expensive studio equipment; avoid recording without it

correct_answer.text: Clear audio keeps viewers engaged; use a cheap lavalier mic or earbuds with a built-in mic

questions.question_text: What is a simple way to build confidence and engage your audience when appearing on camera?

options.text: Memorize a long script to avoid mistakes and sound professional
Avoid looking at the camera to feel less nervous
Talk to the camera like it’s a friend, make eye contact with the lens, and ask viewers questions
Keep videos silent to focus on visuals instead of speaking

correct_answer.text: Talk to the camera like it’s a friend, make eye contact with the lens, and ask viewers questions
